features.description: Repo scaffolding, dependencies installed, init.sh runs cleanly
Regulatory PDFs loaded, chunked, embedded, indexed in Chroma
Query engine returns grounded answers with cited sources for test questions
Intake Agent extracts structured fields from uploaded document using Pydantic schema
Single agent: receives document, extracts fields, retrieves relevant regulation, returns first-pass answer
Orchestrating Compliance Agent calls retrieval, reasons over evidence, produces flagged issues list
Deterministic validation layer checks agent output against rules (not another LLM call)
Custom MCP server exposes regulation lookup tool
Custom MCP server exposes mock account/transaction lookup tool
Custom MCP server exposes internal policy rulebook query tool
Agent calls all three MCP tools correctly during a real run (not hardcoded function calls)
Every extraction/compliance check returns a confidence score grounded in retrieval quality
Agent abstains and routes to human review when confidence is below threshold
Flagged issues require explicit human approval before marked resolved
Labelled test set created (queries + expected outcomes)
Retrieval recall@k measured against test set
Faithfulness / hallucination rate measured
Prompt variant comparison table (at least 2 variants scored)
Every agent run logged: query, tools called, output, confidence, flag status
Dashboard tab shows failure rate, flagged-rate, latency over time
App Dockerized
Deployed to Render (or equivalent), live demo link working end to end
Decision trade-off section written in README (RAG vs fine-tune, MCP vs function calling, single vs multi-agent)
Business impact model: time saved, false escalation cost, adoption scenarios
README + architecture diagram finalized, pushed, presentable
